blocks.text: Level examination 0 · Alphabetization
Instructions
The examination checks all the objectives of the Level 0. About hard 90 minutes plus reading recording; you can split it into two sessions on the same day.
Total 100 80

Overcoming. At least 80 points above 100 and at least the minimum indicated in each section. Before we start. Sections F and G require someone to read: hand over the exam Script to another person at the beginning of the exam solutions (Part IV), or paste those scripts into the voice synthesis app without reading them. Work without notes; Just correct it at the end. If you don't pass the exam. Locate the sections below minimum and return to the corresponding units for 2–4 weeks (table at the bottom of the solutions), then repeat only those sections with different words, which I will prepare you in tutor mode. If you fail the same section again, repeat the module that contains it.
A - Recognition of letters (15 points)
For each form write the name of the letter, the transliteration and the position. One point per voice.
B · Forms and links (10 points)
1. Write the four forms of ⁧ع⁩ (2 points).
2. Write the four forms of ⁧ه⁩ ( 2 points).
3. List the six letters that do not link to the next (2 points).
4. How many connected traits do these words have? (1 (each item) a) ⁧العراق⁩ · b) ⁧وزارة⁩ · c) ⁧طرابلس⁩ · d) ⁧دولية⁩
C · Reading aloud timed (10 points)
Read the text aloud once, recording and timing. You never saw him before.
⁧اليَوْمَ فِي المَطَارِ مُؤْتَمَرٌ صَحَفِيٌّ⁩ . ⁧فِي المَدِينَةِ مَطَارٌ دَوْلِيٌّ وَجَامِعَةٌ وَمُسْتَشْفَيَاتٌ كَثِيرَةٌ⁩
⁧سَأَلَ صَحَفِيٌّ عَنِ التَّحْقِيقِ فِي⁩ . ⁧لِوَزِيرِ الدَّاخِلِيَّةِ، وَالشُّرْطَةُ فِي المَطَارِ وَعَلَى الحُدُودِ⁩
.« ⁧هٰذَا سُؤَالٌ جَيِّدٌ، لٰكِنْ لَا رَدَّ اليَوْمَ⁩ » : ⁧الجَرِيمَةِ، فَقَالَ الوَزِيرُ⁩

Score. The text has 34 words. Listen to the recording with the front text and count errors (wrong letter, wrong voice, wrong length, skipped word). Points = 10 minus number of errors (minimum 0). If you have employed more than 100 seconds (less than 20 words per minute), the maximum score of the section is 5. The paused endings do not count as error.
D · Transliteration (10 points)
E · Scripture from transliteration (10 points)
Write in Arabic with all the vowels.
1. bayt · 2. ad-dīn · 3. wazīr · 4. ḥarb · 5. maǧlis · 6. ṭālib · 7. ḥukūma · 8. raʾīs · 9. šukran · 10. mustašfā
F · Details (10 points)
Listen to the F script (read by another person or vocal synthesis, with 8 seconds between words) and write the ten words with all vowels. One point per word entirely correct.
G · Hearing discrimination (10 points)
Readers pronounce only one word of each pair (script G). Mark a or b.
H · Spelling (10 points)
1. Add the article and transcribe: a) ⁧شَمْس⁩ · b) ⁧قَمَر⁩ ( 2 points)
2. Write in Arabic with vowels: mudarrib (1 (point)
3. Write in Arabic with vowels: a) suʾāl · b) raʾīs (2 points)
4. Complete with ⁧ة⁩ , ⁧ه⁩ or ⁧ت⁩ : a) ◌ ⁧دَوْلـ⁩ (dawla) · b) ◌ ⁧وَجْـ⁩ ( waǧh) (1 point for both)
5. Write the indeterminate accuser (tanwīn -an) of: a) ⁧كِتَاب⁩ · b) ⁧مَدِينَة⁩ ( 2 points)
6. Transcribe how it is pronounced in the related speech: ⁧وَالبَيْت⁩ ( 1 (point)
7. Write in Arabic: ʿalā . ʿAlī Ali (1 point for both)
Reading without vowels (10 points)
For each title: write the transliteration (1 point) and translation (1 point (b).
⁧حكومة جديدة في لبنان⁩ . ⁧١⁩
⁧تحقيق الشرطة في مطار بغداد⁩ . ⁧٢⁩
⁧سؤال إلى وزير الداخلية⁩ . ⁧٣⁩
⁧مؤتمر صحفي للرئيس⁩ . ⁧٤⁩
⁧الجيش على حدود ليبيا⁩ . ⁧٥⁩
Vocabulary (5 points)
Translate: 1. ⁧أَمْن⁩ · 2. ⁧حِزْب⁩ · 3. ⁧جَرِيمَة⁩ · 4. ⁧دَوْلَة⁩ · 5. ⁧شَعْب⁩
To be consulted only after replying. Letters and traits of the disarrays are in Arabic order, from right to left
